text:
Aisha R.: Quick flag: after int8 rollout for mariner-v1 we see a reproducible quality drop on the cjk-vertical-emoji suite (HK vertical + emoji). BLEU ~ -4.9 on nightly.

eval-bot: Regression alert: mariner-v1 (int8) | cjk_vertical_emoji_v3 | BLEU -4.9 | 2026-03-25T14:02Z. Link: https://console.redwood/ops/regressions/INF-10421

Tomo S.: Can you share a minimal repro + tokenizer id dump?

Aisha R.: Repro (run from evals):
```bash
python -m evals.run --model mariner-v1 --quant int8 --suite cjk_vertical_emoji_v3 --batch 12
```
Sample raw input: "\u9999\u6e2f\ud83c\udded\ud83c\uddf0\n\u4e2d\u6587\u00b7\u6ce8\u97f3"
Gold detok: "\u9999\u6e2f \ud83c\udded\ud83c\uddf0\n\u4e2d\u6587\u00b7\u6ce8\u97f3"
mariner-v1 int8 detok: "\u9999\u6e2f\u200b\ud83c\udded\ud83c\uddf0\n\u4e2d\u6587\u00b7\u6ce8\u200b\u97f3"  <-- unexpected U+200B around emoji/particle

Diego M.: Token id dumps (tokenizer binary used in int8 image):
[402, 1800, 7, 3120]  # gold
[402, 1800, 7, 3120]  # mariner fp32
[402, 1800, 7, 99, 3120]  # mariner int8 -> id 99 looks like control (ZWSP)

Tomo S.: Interesting: id is present pre-decoding, so packaging or tokenizer wheel for int8 image likely introduced it. Any infra kernel rollouts recently?

Aisha R.: Infra notes: image build bumped tokenizer wheel on 2026-03-23 in the int8 image; runtime rolled `kv-optimize-v4` on 03/24. Bisecting image layers now.

Diego M.: Short-term mitigation: I added a sanitizer to the eval pipeline to strip U+200B post-detok (staging only) and added a smoke check for cjk_vertical_emoji_v3. Patch: https://phabricator.redwood/r/PR-6021

Tomo S.: Please also add a unit in tokenizer tests to assert no ZWSP insertion for CJK+emoji combos. Prefer fix in tokenizer normalization (pre-tokenize) rather than post-detok. I'll freeze int8 image rollouts until bisect completes.

Aisha R.: Running bisect on the tokenizer wheel now; will report offending wheel version. Created INF-10421 with payloads and logs.

Diego M.: +1 on upstream tokenizer fix. Post-detok sanitizer is temporary. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
